items.front: C.V. Raman — discovery, Nobel year, national day?
items.back: Raman Effect (light scattering, 1928); Nobel Physics 1930 (first Asian science Nobel); 28 Feb = National Science Day; Bharat Ratna 1954.
items.examPoint: C.V. Raman — Raman Effect (1928), Nobel Physics 1930, National Science Day (28 Feb), Bharat Ratna 1954

items.front: Match Bose, Saha, Chandrasekhar to their ideas?
items.back: S.N. Bose = Bose-Einstein statistics/boson; Meghnad Saha = thermal ionization equation; Chandrasekhar = 1.44 M☉ limit (Nobel 1983).
items.examPoint: S. Chandrasekhar — Chandrasekhar limit (~1.44 solar masses); Nobel Physics 1983

items.back: Wireless/microwave research before Marconi; invented the crescograph (plant growth); founded Bose Institute (1917).
items.examPoint: J.C. Bose — plant response & crescograph; wireless/microwave research before Marconi; Bose Institute

items.front: Fathers of India's nuclear vs space programmes?
items.back: Nuclear = Homi Bhabha (TIFR, AEC, 3-stage, BARC). Space = Vikram Sarabhai (PRL Ahmedabad, INCOSPAR → ISRO 1969).
items.examPoint: Homi J. Bhabha — father of Indian nuclear programme; cascade/Bhabha scattering; AEC, TIFR, BARC

items.back: Pure maths: number theory, infinite series; worked with G.H. Hardy; FRS 1918; 22 Dec = National Mathematics Day.
items.examPoint: Srinivasa Ramanujan — number theory & infinite series; Hardy; National Mathematics Day (22 Dec)

items.front: Khorana and Ramakrishnan — Nobel years and subjects?
items.back: Khorana: 1968 Medicine (genetic code). Ramakrishnan: 2009 Chemistry (ribosome structure).
items.examPoint: Har Gobind Khorana — genetic code & protein synthesis; Nobel Medicine 1968

items.back: SLV-III, IGMDP (Agni/Prithvi), Pokhran-II 1998; President 2002-07; Bharat Ratna 1997. 'Missile Man'.
items.examPoint: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — SLV-III, IGMDP missiles, Pokhran-II, President; Bharat Ratna 1997

items.front: Green vs White Revolution — who led each?
items.back: Green Revolution = M.S. Swaminathan (Bharat Ratna 2024, posthumous). White Revolution = Verghese Kurien (Operation Flood, Amul, NDDB).
items.examPoint: M.S. Swaminathan — Green Revolution; Bharat Ratna 2024 (posthumous)

items.back: Born Bhimavaram (AP); synthesised folic acid & methotrexate (anti-cancer), diethylcarbamazine (filariasis), ATP's energy role.
items.examPoint: Yellapragada Subbarao (AP, Bhimavaram) — folic acid, methotrexate, diethylcarbamazine, ATP role

items.front: Women scientists: Tessy Thomas, Ritu Karidhal, Nigar Shaji?
items.back: Tessy Thomas = Agni missiles (DRDO, 'Missile Woman'); Ritu Karidhal = Mangalyaan/Chandrayaan (ISRO); Nigar Shaji = Aditya-L1 PD.
items.examPoint: Contemporary women scientists — Tessy Thomas, Ritu Karidhal, Nigar Shaji
